headline: Margins widen sharply, but net income dips
summary_short: Workday reported FY2026 Q2 revenue of $2,542M and diluted EPS of $0.87, with operating income up 36.3% y/y to $338M (31.8% non-GAAP operating margin) even as GAAP net income slipped 2.6% y/y to $222M on the shard's recorded comparison basis.
summary_long: Total revenue was $2,542M, with subscription revenue of $2,354M up 14.3% y/y per the release's own comparison. The year-ago quarter's operating income was depressed by a $166M restructuring charge that did not recur, so non-GAAP operating margin rose to 31.8% from 30.2%. Free cash flow was $616M, up from $421M. Workday repurchased $1.6B of stock (~12.0M shares) and held $4.35B in cash and marketable securities at quarter-end. Management raised full-year FY2027 non-GAAP operating margin guidance to 30.5% while reiterating subscription revenue guidance of $9.925B-$9.950B, and guided Q2 FY2027 subscription revenue to $2.455B, up 13%.

The correct earnings 8-K (items 2.02 and 9.01, accession 0001327811-26-000024, filed 2026-05-21, matching this event's eventDate exactly) was located via the EDGAR CIK browse list, and its EX-99.1 exhibit (wday-04302026x991.htm) was fetched and read directly. Ledger inconsistency found and NOT corrected here (per 'note, don't massage'): this release's own income statement reports 'three months ended April 30, 2025' figures of revenue $2,240M, operating income $39M (depressed by a $166M restructuring charge), net income $68M, and diluted EPS $0.25 — but the shard's sibling event labeled 'FY2025 Q2' (eventDate 2025-04-30) currently stores actuals of revenue $2,348M, operating income $248M, net income $228M, and diluted EPS $0.84, each carrying asOf=2025-07-31 from an SEC-XBRL rederive pass, i.e. apparently a different quarter's figures than what that event's own eventDate implies. This KPI table above uses the resolver's stored prior_yy values per the standard /earnings procedure, so the y/y deltas shown (+8.3% revenue, +36.3% operating income, -2.6% net income, +3.6% diluted EPS) do not match what the filing's own comparison column would imply (+13.5% revenue and much larger swings for operating income and net income given the year-ago restructuring charge). This looks like a fiscal-period-matching defect on WDAY's shard (Workday's non-calendar Jan 31 fiscal year-end); flagging for a future backfill pass rather than hand-correcting it here.

drivers.explanation: CEO said Workday is "ready for this AI moment," citing a strong core business and agentic AI adoption across HR, finance, and IT.
Free cash flow rose to $616M from $421M and Workday repurchased $1.6B of stock (~12.0M shares) during the quarter.
CFO cited "ongoing customer adoption across our platform" and 14.3% y/y subscription revenue growth as the driver of total revenue growth.
The year-ago quarter included a $166M restructuring charge that did not recur this quarter, lifting reported operating income and non-GAAP margin by comparison.
Provision for income taxes rose to $133M from $35M and other income fell to $17M from $64M in the filing's own comparison, offsetting higher pretax income.
